description: No thromboprophylaxis prescribed at discharge despite recent major orthopedic surgery and early discontinuation of enoxaparin.
evidence_in_history: Enoxaparin prescribed post-op (40 mg SC once daily) but discontinued on 2023-02-10; no further anticoagulation documented.
evidence_in_summary: Discharge medications do not include any thromboprophylaxis; noted that no thromboprophylaxis prescribed at discharge.
suggested_correction: Consider prescribing or documenting rationale for absence of thromboprophylaxis after total hip arthroplasty; arrange monitoring or alternative thromboprophylaxis if indicated.
